name: fix_php_switch_missing_break_permissions
description: Fixes a PHP switch whose `admin` case is missing a break and falls through to the default empty list
prompts: Permissions::forRole in src/Permissions.php maps viewer -> [read], editor -> [read, write], admin -> [read, write, delete], and any other role -> []. There is a bug: the `admin` case is missing its `break`, so it falls through into the `default` branch and forRole("admin") wrongly returns an empty array. Fix the control flow so each role returns exactly its documented permission list. Keep the class and method signatures.

setup_files.src/Permissions.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class Permissions
{
    // Map a role name to its permission list:
    //   viewer -> [read]; editor -> [read, write];
    //   admin  -> [read, write, delete]; anything else -> [].
    // BUG: the `admin` case is missing its `break`, so execution falls
    // through into `default` and admin wrongly comes back as an empty list.
    public function forRole(string $role): array
    {
        switch ($role) {
            case "viewer":
                $perms = ["read"];
                break;
            case "editor":
                $perms = ["read", "write"];
                break;
            case "admin":
                $perms = ["read", "write", "delete"];
            default:
                $perms = [];
        }
        return $perms;
    }
}

test_setup_files.tests/PermissionsHiddenTest.php:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/Permissions.php';

final class PermissionsHiddenTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testViewer(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(["read"], (new \App\Permissions())->forRole("viewer"));
    }

    public function testEditor(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(["read", "write"], (new \App\Permissions())->forRole("editor"));
    }

    public function testAdmin(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(["read", "write", "delete"], (new \App\Permissions())->forRole("admin"));
    }

    public function testUnknownRole(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame([], (new \App\Permissions())->forRole("guest"));
    }
}
